verdict.rationale: Gusto's first-party Embedded Payroll docs describe webhooks as HTTP requests that deliver event information as it happens, so a partner application can run business logic on receipt. The documented event catalog covers payroll, bank account, company, contractor, signatory, document and notification events. API access, and so webhook access, is limited to App Integration and Embedded Payroll partners. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the subscription/registration mechanics and payload verification in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration, and availability beyond approved partners.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: A webhook is an HTTP request that delivers information about an event as it happens. We recommend that you integrate with Gusto’s webhooks infrastructure so that your application can perform subsequent business logic after it receives a webhook event.
Event catalog spans payroll, bank account, company, contractor, signatory, document and notification events.
